), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            if not pause(0.7) then break end
            dToast.Visible = false
            TweenService:Create(dBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.13, 0.45) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(dBtnScale, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Scale = 0.6 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(dFinger, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.9) }):Play()
            caption("Tu botón flotante, a tu gusto", "Your floating button, your way")
            if not pause(2.2) then break end
        end
    end
    local function startDemo()
        demoGen += 1
        task.spawn(runDemo, demoGen)
    end
    local function stopDemo()
        demoGen += 1
        if ringTween then ringTween:Cancel() ringTween = nil end
    end
    return startDemo, stopDemo
    end)()

    local function refreshBuyText()
        if PR.price then
            L(PBuyText, "Comprar · R$ " .. PR.price, "Buy · R$ " .. PR.price)
        else
            L(PBuyText, "Comprar en Roblox", "Buy on Roblox")
        end
    end
    local function closeSheet()
        TweenService:Create(PScale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.92 }):Play()
        task.delay(0.14, function() PSheet.Visible = false end)
        stopDemo()
    end
    local function showSheet()
        refreshBuyText()
        if PR.checking then
            L(PStatus, "Verificando tu cuenta...", "Checking your account...")
        else
            L(PStatus, "", "")
        end
        PSheet.Visible = true
        startDemo()
        PScale.Scale = 0.9
        TweenService:Create(PScale, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
    end
    PClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeSheet)
    PBuy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
        local ok = pcall(function()
            MPS:PromptGamePassPurchase(LocalPlayer, PASS_ID)
        end)
        if type(setclipboard) == "function" then pcall(setclipboard, PASS_URL) end
        if ok then
            L(PStatus, "Se abrió la compra de Roblox · el link también quedó copiado", "Roblox purchase opened · link also copied")
        else
            L(PStatus, "Link copiado: compralo en el navegador y tocá Ya lo compré", "Link copied: buy it in the browser and tap I already bought it")
        end
    end)
    PCheck.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        L(PStatus, "Verificando tu cuenta...", "Checking your account...")
        PR.check()
    end)

    -- entrada única al editor: sin el pase se muestra la hoja premium
    local function guardedOpen(id)
        if PR.owned then
            openEditor(id)
        else
            showSheet()
        end
    end
    LS.Open = guardedOpen
    LS.Premium = PR
    FloatingPillV5.Studio.SetPremium(PR, showSheet) -- el mismo pase desbloquea el Estudio de Toggles Flotantes
    -- la hoja reacciona cuando termina una verificación o una compra
    table.insert(PR.listeners, function(owned)
        if not PSheet.Visible then return end
        refreshBuyText()
        if PR.checking then
            L(PStatus, "Verificando tu cuenta...", "Checking your account...")
        elseif owned then
            L(PStatus, "¡Listo! Ya tenés el Studio Logos", "Done! You now have Studio Logos")
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
            task.delay(0.9, closeSheet)
        else
            L(PStatus, "Todavía no figura la compra en tu cuenta", "The purchase isn't on your account yet")
        end
    end)

    local function header(order, es, en, subEs, subEn)
        local h = mk("Frame", { Parent = LogoPage, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 11 })
        local t = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = h, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 12 })
        t:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        L(t, es, en)
        local d = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = h, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 13), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 19), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim, TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 12 })
        d:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
        d:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        L(d, subEs, subEn)
        return h, d
    end

                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.Accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.Accent),
            }),

        goldGradient(lbStroke, 45)

    local function customCard(id, rec, order)
        local key = CL.Key(id)
        local icon = IconCatalog.Icons[key]
        local c = mk("Frame", { Parent = MineGrid, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 12 })
        c:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        corner(c, 14)
        local cStroke = stroke(c, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
        local sc = mk("UIScale", { Parent = c, Scale = 1 })
        local stage = mk("Frame", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 58), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 13 })
        stage:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        corner(stage, 999)
        local ring = stroke(stage, Theme.Stroke, 2, 0.7)
        composite(stage, icon, 54, 14)
        local name = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 68), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = rec.Name, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 14 })
        name:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        local badge = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, Text = "", Visible = false, ZIndex = 15 })
        badge:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(badge, 999)
        RowKit.Icon(badge, 103456899356871, 12, 16, "AccentText")
        local hit = mk("TextButton", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", ZIndex = 16 })
        -- acciones: editar / borrar (borrar pide un segundo toque)
        local edit = mk("TextButton", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -26), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 17 })
        edit:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        edit:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        L(edit, "Editar", "Edit")
        corner(edit, 999)
        local del = mk("TextButton", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 1, -26), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 17 })
        del:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        del:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        L(del, "Borrar", "Delete")
        corner(del, 999)
        local entry = { card = c, stroke = cStroke, ring = ring, badge = badge, name = name, key = key, custom = true }
        LP.cards[#LP.cards + 1] = entry
        LP.paint(entry, SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon == key, false)
        hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            sc.Scale = 0.93
            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon = key
            SaveConfig()
            ApplyLogoIcon(key)
            for _, other in ipairs(LP.cards) do
                LP.paint(other, other.key == key, true)
            end
            LP.setHero(key)
        end)
        edit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            guardedOpen(id)
        end)
        local armed = false
        del.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not armed then
                armed = true
                L(del, "¿Seguro?", "Sure?")
                del.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 70)
                del.TextColor3 = WHITE
                task.delay(3, function()
                    if armed and del.Parent then
                        armed = false
                        L(del, "Borrar", "Delete")
                        del.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background
                        del.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
                    end
                end)
                return
            end
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            CL.Remove(id)
            if SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon == key then
                SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon = "ClassicYinYang"
                SaveConfig()
                ApplyLogoIcon("ClassicYinYang")
                LP.setHero("ClassicYinYang")
                for _, other in ipairs(LP.cards) do
                    LP.paint(other, other.key == "ClassicYinYang", true)
                end
            end
            LS.RefreshCards()
        end)
    end

    function LS.RefreshCards()
        for i = #LP.cards, 1, -1 do
            if LP.cards[i].custom then
                LP.cards[i].card:Destroy()
                table.remove(LP.cards, i)
            end
        end
        for i, id in ipairs(CL.Order) do
            local rec = CL.Logos[id]
            if rec and IconCatalog.Icons[CL.Key(id)] then
                customCard(id, rec, i)
            end
        end
        local n = #CL.Order
        if n == 0 then
            L(MineSub, "Creá tu propio botón flotante con tus imágenes", "Create your own floating button with your images")
        else
            L(MineSub, n .. " de " .. CL.Max .. " · tocá uno para usarlo", n .. " of " .. CL.Max .. " · tap one to use it")
        end
    end
    LS.RefreshCards()
    LP.studio = LS
    PR.check()
    end
    BuildLogoStudio()

    local firstIcon = nil
    for i, name in ipairs(IconCatalog.Order or { "ClassicYinYang" }) do
        local data = IconCatalog.Icons[name]
        if data then
            firstIcon = firstIcon or name
            CreateIconCard(name, data, i)
        end
    end
    LP.setHero(IconCatalog.Icons[SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or ""] and SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or firstIcon)
    end
    BuildLogoTab()

        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        ZIndex = 10,
    })
    CL.search:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    CL.search:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "Buscar script...")
    CL.search:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Search script...")
    CL.search.Focused:Connect(function()
        searchStroke.Color = Theme.Accent
        searchStroke.Transparency = 0.1
    end)
    CL.search.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        searchStroke.Color = Theme.Stroke
        searchStroke.Transparency = 0.6
    end)

    CL.empty = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = ClassicPage,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextWrapped = true,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 9,
    })
    CL.empty:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")

    function CL.refresh()
        local active = 0
        for _, h in ipairs(CL.holders) do
            local st = h.holder:GetAttribute("ScriptState")
            if st == "active" or st == "loading" then active = active + 1 end
        end
        CL.countChip.Text = GetText(#CL.holders .. " scripts", #CL.holders .. " scripts")
        CL.activeChip.Text = GetText(active .. " activos", active .. " active")
    end

    function CL.filter()
        local q = string.lower(CL.search.Text or "")
        local shown = 0
        for _, h in ipairs(CL.holders) do
            local match = q == "" or string.find(h.es, q, 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(h.en, q, 1, true) ~= nil
            h.holder.Visible = match
            if match then shown = shown + 1 end
        end
        if #CL.holders == 0 then
            CL.empty.Text = GetText("No se pudo cargar la lista de scripts.", "Could not load the script list.")
            CL.empty.Visible = true
        elseif shown == 0 then
            CL.empty.Text = GetText("Ningún script coincide con la búsqueda.", "No script matches your search.")
            CL.empty.Visible = true
        else
            CL.empty.Visible = false
        end
    end
    CL.search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(CL.filter)

    for _, entry in ipairs(classicScripts) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.es and entry.en and entry.file and entry.key then
            local holder = TabClassic:CreateScriptToggle(
                tostring(entry.es),
                tostring(entry.en),
                entry.url and tostring(entry.url) or CLASSIC_SCRIPT_URL,
                tostring(entry.key)
            )
            if holder then
                table.insert(CL.holders, {holder = holder, es = string.lower(tostring(entry.es)), en = string.lower(tostring(entry.en))})
                holder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ScriptState"):Connect(CL.refresh)
            end
        else
            warn("[YinYang Classic] Entrada de manifest inválida; se omite")
        end
    end
    CL.refresh()
    CL.filter()
    end
    Window:CreateClassicTab()

    function Window:CreateSpotifyTab()
    local STab = Window:CreateTab("Spotify", "Spotify", "rbxassetid://97213700655604")
    local SPage = STab.Page

    SPage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    SPage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SPage.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    SPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    SPage.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    SPage.ScrollingEnabled = false

    -- Capa estática de brillo ahumado; si falla la descarga, conserva el panel normal.
    local function spotifyGlass(parent, z)
        local overlay = mk("ImageLabel", {Parent = parent, Name = "SpotifyGlass", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "", ImageTransparency = 0.76,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, Active = false, ZIndex = z})
        corner(overlay, 10)
        YinIcons.get("spotify-glass", function(image) if overlay.Parent then overlay.Image = image end end)
    end

    -- Fondo continuo y geometría temporal mientras Spotify está seleccionado.
    do
        local A = {Active = false, Cover = "", Saved = {}}
        Window._SpotifyAmbient = A
        A.Frame = mk("Frame", {
            Name = "SpotifyAmbient", Parent = Main, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14), BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 5,
        })
        corner(A.Frame, 10)
        A.Image = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = A.Frame, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1.80, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, -0.69, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = "", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ImageTransparency = 0.12, ZIndex = 5,
        })
        local shade = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = A.Frame, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 10),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5,
        })
        mk("UIGradient", {Parent = shade, Rotation = 90,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})})

        function A.SetCover(cover)
            A.Cover = type(cover) == "string" and cover or ""
            A.Image.Image = A.Cover
            A.Image.Visible = A.Cover ~= ""
        end
        function A.Layout()
            if not A.Active then return end
            local compact = Window.CompactNavigation == true
            TabListArt.Visible = false
            CatImage.Visible = false
            local rail = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactTabRail")
            if rail then rail.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
            local side = compact and 58 or 110
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, side, 0, -56)
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -side, 1, 56)
            if A.LayoutCatalog then A.LayoutCatalog(compact) end
            if A.LayoutPlayer then A.LayoutPlayer(compact) end
            if A.LayoutFavorites then A.LayoutFavorites(compact) end
        end
        function A.enter()
            if A.Active then return end
            A.Active = true
            A.Saved = {visible = {}, tabTransparency = TabList.BackgroundTransparency,
                topTransparency = TopBar.BackgroundTransparency, titleSize = TitleLabel.Size,
                contentPosition = ContentArea.Position, contentSize = ContentArea.Size,
                titleStroke = TitleLabel.TextStrokeTransparency, badgeStroke = DaraHubLabel.TextStrokeTransparency,
                titleStrokeColor = TitleLabel.TextStrokeColor3, badgeStrokeColor = DaraHubLabel.TextStrokeColor3,
                titleZ = TitleLabel.ZIndex, badgeZ = DaraHubLabel.ZIndex, badgeFrameZ = DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex}
            for _, obj in ipairs({BannerFrame, BoomboxPill, WindowControls, TopBarCounter,
                TitleDivider, TopBarArt, TabListArt, CatImage, BackgroundArt, Main:FindFirstChild("RotatingSubText")}) do
                if obj then A.Saved.visible[obj] = obj.Visible; obj.Visible = false end
            end
            A.Frame.Visible = true
            A.SetCover(A.Cover)
            TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TabList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(106, 26)
            TitleLabel.ZIndex = 60
            DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex = 60
            DaraHubLabel.ZIndex = 61
            TitleLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            TitleLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
            DaraHubLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            DaraHubLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs or {}) do
                if tab.Button then tab.Button.BackgroundTransparency = tab.Page and tab.Page.Visible and 0.35 or 1 end
            end
            A.Layout()
            if Window._RefreshCompactNavigation then Window._RefreshCompactNavigation() end
        end
        function A.leave()
            if not A.Active then return end
            A.Active = false
            A.Frame.Visible = false
            for obj, visible in pairs(A.Saved.visible or {}) do if obj.Parent then obj.Visible = visible end end
            TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = A.Saved.topTransparency
            TitleLabel.Size = A.Saved.titleSize
            TitleLabel.ZIndex = A.Saved.titleZ
            DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex = A.Saved.badgeFrameZ
            DaraHubLabel.ZIndex = A.Saved.badgeZ
            TitleLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = A.Saved.titleStroke
            DaraHubLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = A.Saved.badgeStroke
            TitleLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = A.Saved.titleStrokeColor
            DaraHubLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = A.Saved.badgeStrokeColor
            TabList.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
            local compact = Window.CompactNavigation == true
            TabListArt.Visible = not compact
            CatImage.Visible = (not compact) and Theme.ThemeName == "Dark"
            local rail = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactTabRail")
            if rail then rail.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
            local side = compact and 58 or 110
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, side, 0, 0)
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -side, 1, 0)
            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs or {}) do
                if tab.Button then
                    tab.Button.BackgroundTransparency = tab.Page and tab.Page.Visible and 0 or (Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0)
                end
            end
            if Window._RefreshCompactNavigation then Window._RefreshCompactNavigation() end
        end
        track(SPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
            task.defer(function()
                if SPage.Parent then if SPage.Visible then A.enter() else A.leave() end end
            end)
        end))
        if SPage.Visible then A.enter() end
    end

    local SPOTIFY_CATALOG_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YinScripts/Yin-music/refs/heads/main/YinYang_Spotify"

    local function asset(id)
        return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
    end

    local function trim(s)
        return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
    end

    local function clamp(v, minV, maxV)
        if v < minV then return minV end
        if v > maxV then return maxV end
        return v
    end

    local function durationToSeconds(duration)
        if type(duration) == "number" then
            return math.max(0, math.floor(duration))
        end

        local text = trim(duration)
        if text == "" then
            return 0
        end

        local mm, ss = text:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")
        if mm and ss then
            return tonumber(mm) * 60 + tonumber(ss)
        end

        local numeric = tonumber(text)
        return numeric and math.max(0, math.floor(numeric)) or 0
    end

    local function secondsToClock(seconds)
        seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(seconds) or 0))
        local mm = math.floor(seconds / 60)
        local ss = seconds % 60
        return string.format("%d:%02d", mm, ss)
    end

    local function safeDestroy(instance)
        if instance then
            pcall(function()
                instance:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end

    local function destroyAllSpotifySounds()
        local function clean(parent)
            if not parent then
                return
            end
            for _, inst in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                if inst:IsA("Sound") and inst.Name == "YY_Spotify_CurrentSound" then
                    pcall(function()
                        inst:Stop()
                    end)
                    safeDestroy(inst)
                end
            end
        end

        clean(workspace)
        if game:GetService("SoundService") then
            clean(game:GetService("SoundService"))
        end
    end

    local function normalizeTrack(track, index)
        if type(track) ~= "table" then
            return nil
        end

        local name = track.Name or track.name or track.Title or track.title or ("Track " .. tostring(index))
        local artist = track.Artist or track.artist or ""
        local duration = track.Duration or track.duration or "0:00"
        if type(duration) == "number" then
            duration = secondsToClock(duration)
        else
            duration = trim(duration)
            if duration == "" then
                duration = "0:00"
            end
        end

        local cover = track.Cover or track.cover or track.CoverId or track.coverId or track.coverUrl or ""
        local coverDownloadUrl = track.CoverURL or track.coverURL or track.CoverUrl or ""
        local audioUrl = track.AudioURL or track.audioUrl or track.AudioUrl or track.audioURL or ""

        local safeName = tostring(name):lower():gsub("[^%w]+", "_"):gsub("_+", "_"):gsub("^_", ""):gsub("_$", "")
        if safeName == "" then
            safeName = "track_" .. tostring(index)
        end

        local cacheName = track.CacheName or track.cacheName or track.audioFile or track.AudioFile
        if not cacheName or trim(cacheName) == "" then
            cacheName = safeName .. ".mp3"
        end

        local coverCacheName = track.CoverCacheName or track.coverCacheName or ""
        if trim(coverDownloadUrl) ~= "" and trim(coverCacheName) == "" then
            local urlWithoutQuery = tostring(coverDownloadUrl):match("^[^%?#]+") or tostring(coverDownloadUrl)
            local urlExt = urlWithoutQuery:match("%.([%w]+)$")
            urlExt = (urlExt and urlExt ~= "" and #urlExt <= 5) and urlExt:lower() or "png"
            coverCacheName = safeName .. "_cover." .. urlExt
        end

        local id = track.Id or track.id or track.ID or tostring(index)

        return {
            Id = id,
            Name = tostring(name),
            Artist = tostring(artist),
            Duration = duration,
            Cover = tostring(cover),
            CoverURL = tostring(coverDownloadUrl),
            CoverCacheName = tostring(coverCacheName),
            AudioURL = tostring(audioUrl),
            CacheName = tostring(cacheName),
            IsUserSong = track.IsUserSong == true,
            Raw = track,
        }
    end

    local SpotifyState = {
        Catalog = {},
        SelectedIndex = 1,
        IsPlaying = false,
        IsRepeat = false,
        CurrentLiked = {},
        RowButtons = {},
        HiddenRows = {},
        CurrentSound = nil,
        SoundProgressConnection = nil,
        SoundEndedConnection = nil,
        CurrentTrack = nil,
        CurrentTrackSeconds = 0,
        CurrentPausedPosition = 0,
        CatalogLoaded = false,
        SearchQuery = "",
        PlaybackVolume = 0.75,
        PlaybackSpeed = 1,
        SettingsMenuVisible = false,
        FloatingPlayerVisible = false,
        FavoritesView = false,
        MySongsView = false,
        UserSongs = {},
    }

    local refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer = function() end
    local refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu = function() end

    local function getRenderOrder()
        local order = {}
        for i = 1, #SpotifyState.Catalog do
            order[#order + 1] = i
        end

        table.sort(order, function(a, b)
            local likedA = SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[a] == true
            local likedB = SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[b] == true
            if likedA ~= likedB then
                return likedA and not likedB
            end
            return a < b
        end)

        return order
    end


    local function normalizeSearchText(value)
        local s = tostring(value or "")
        local replacements = {
            ["á"] = "a", ["à"] = "a", ["ä"] = "a", ["â"] = "a", ["ã"] = "a", ["å"] = "a",
            ["Á"] = "a", ["À"] = "a", ["Ä"] = "a", ["Â"] = "a", ["Ã"] = "a", ["Å"] = "a",
            ["é"] = "e", ["è"] = "e", ["ë"] = "e", ["ê"] = "e",
            ["É"] = "e", ["È"] = "e", ["Ë"] = "e", ["Ê"] = "e",
            ["í"] = "i", ["ì"] = "i", ["ï"] = "i", ["î"] = "i",
            ["Í"] = "i", ["Ì"] = "i", ["Ï"] = "i", ["Î"] = "i",
            ["ó"] = "o", ["ò"] = "o", ["ö"] = "o", ["ô"] = "o", ["õ"] = "o",
            ["Ó"] = "o", ["Ò"] = "o", ["Ö"] = "o", ["Ô"] = "o", ["Õ"] = "o",
            ["ú"] = "u", ["ù"] = "u", ["ü"] = "u", ["û"] = "u",
            ["Ú"] = "u", ["Ù"] = "u", ["Ü"] = "u", ["Û"] = "u",
            ["ñ"] = "n", ["Ñ"] = "n",
            ["ç"] = "c", ["Ç"] = "c",
        }
        for from, to in pairs(replacements) do
            s = s:gsub(from, to)
        end
        s = s:lower()
        s = trim(s)
        return s
    end

    local function getVisibleRenderOrder()
        local query = normalizeSearchText(SpotifyState.SearchQuery or "")
        local order = getRenderOrder()
        local filtered = {}

        for _, index in ipairs(order) do
            local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            local matchesView = true
            if SpotifyState.MySongsView then
                matchesView = track ~= nil and track.IsUserSong == true
            elseif SpotifyState.FavoritesView then
                matchesView = SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] == true
            end
            if matchesView then
                filtered[#filtered + 1] = index
            end
        end

        if query == "" then
            return filtered
        end

        local tokens = {}
        for token in query:gmatch("%S+") do
            tokens[#tokens + 1] = token
        end

        table.clear(filtered)
        for _, index in ipairs(order) do
            local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            if SpotifyState.MySongsView and (not track or track.IsUserSong ~= true) then
                continue
            end
            if not SpotifyState.MySongsView and SpotifyState.FavoritesView and SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] ~= true then
                continue
            end
            if track then
                local haystack = normalizeSearchText((track.Name or "") .. " " .. (track.Artist or "") .. " " .. (track.Duration or ""))
                local matched = true

                for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do
                    if not haystack:find(token, 1, true) then
                        matched = false
                        break
                    end
                end

                if matched then
                    filtered[#filtered + 1] = index
                end
            end
        end
        return filtered
    end

    local spotifyGreen = Color3.fromRGB(29, 185, 84)
    local spotifyText = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
    local spotifyDim = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)

    local spotifyPanel = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

    local function spotifyLogicalSize(gui)
        local scale, node = 1, gui
        while node and not node:IsA("LayerCollector") do
            local uiScale = node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            if uiScale then scale = scale * uiScale.Scale end
            node = node.Parent
        end
        return gui.AbsoluteSize / math.max(scale, 0.01)
    end

    local function getSpotifyMetrics()
        local width, height = 0, 0
        pcall(function()
            local logical = spotifyLogicalSize(SPage)
            width, height = logical.X, logical.Y
        end)

        local compact = width > 0 and width < 640
        local gridColumns = 3
        local gridGapX = width > 0 and (width < 420 and 8 or 12) or 10
        local gridGapY = width > 0 and (width < 420 and 12 or 16) or 12
        -- Dos filas visibles, con límites para mantener controles legibles en móviles.
        local cardHeight = SpotifyState._CatalogCardHeight or (height > 0 and math.clamp(math.floor((height - 166) / 2), 84, 164) or 140)
        local coverMax = math.max(32, cardHeight - 46)

        return {
            compact = compact,
            playerHeight = compact and 200 or 220,
            albumSize = compact and 130 or 150,
            albumTop = compact and 32 or 36,
            infoLeft = compact and 154 or 174,
            infoWidth = compact and -172 or -192,
            titleSize = compact and 20 or 22,
            artistSize = compact and 13 or 14,
            metaSize = compact and 10 or 11,
            progressBottom = compact and -30 or -34,
            controlsBottom = compact and -46 or -52,
            controlsHeight = compact and 40 or 44,
            repeatX = compact and 0.06 or 0.05,
            likeX = compact and 0.15 or 0.14,
            playX = compact and 0.59 or 0.58,
            nextX = compact and 0.85 or 0.87,
            moreX = compact and 0.95 or 0.96,
            playSize = compact and 30 or 34,
            rowHeight = compact and 64 or 70,
            rowCover = compact and 44 or 50,
            rowTitleSize = compact and 14 or 15,
